# filemanager_ftp_operation (Resource)

Performs operations on FTP files such as head, copy, or rename.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `operation` (String) Operation to perform. Valid values: head, copy, rename.
- `path` (String) Path to the file on the FTP server.
- `service` (String) FTP service alias (from filemanager_ftp_service resource).

### Optional

- `destination_path` (String) Destination path for copy or rename operations.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the resource.
- `is_dir` (Boolean) Whether the path is a directory.
- `mod_time` (String) Last modification time of the file.
- `name` (String) Base name of the file.
- `permissions` (String) File permissions in octal format.
- `size` (Number) Size of the file in bytes.
